2023_19_jul_2023_financial_statement.paragraph: First monthly financial report of the fiscal year that began July 1, 2023 for the Troy School District, covering July 1 through July 31, 2023 (unaudited) and presented at the September 19, 2023 board meeting, against the budget adopted 6/13/23.
